ui.title: Shadowbox Studio
ui.tagline: Backlit cut-paper diorama with layered parallax

palette.hint: Switch paper stocks and sky tint

light_intensity.hint: Dial up the rear lamp glow

listing.blurb: Silhouetted paper hills and pine trees drift in parallax against a warm backlit cutout moon, casting soft drop shadows and pooling ambient valley mist.
listing.prompt: A layered paper-cut diorama lit from behind: eight cut-paper layers of hills, trees and a crescent moon, each layer a shade deeper, drifting in parallax, a warm light glowing through the gaps. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
